svg.title: Bayu Anchor on the Bayu Core carrier
svg.desc: Connector map of the planned Bayu Core carrier board for the Anchor role: XIAO ESP32-S3 socket, J1 JST GH 6-pin for the SEN54, J2 PicoBlade 8-pin for the PMS5003, J3 and J4 Grove I2C, J5 Grove GPIO, J6 JST PH 5 V input, fuse, pull-ups and test pads.
svg.text: Bayu Anchor on the Bayu Core carrier, connector map
Phase 1, planned and not yet laid out: positions are indicative, pin numbers and nets are not. Top view, 60 × 40 mm, 11 px = 1 mm.
JST GH 6-pin cable, 10 cm or less
SEL tied to GND on the board
fan sleeps when D2 goes low
F1 1 A resettable fuse from XIAO VBUS to the 5 V rail.
J6 5 V in from the Power board, after F1. Wall-powered Anchors leave it empty.
R1, R2 4.7 kΩ pull-ups on SDA and SCL to 3V3, enabled by solder jumper JP1.
Close JP1 for the Anchor: the bare SEN54 has no pull-ups.
J1 pin 5 SEL goes to GND on the board, which selects I²C on the SEN54.
J2 pin 6 RESET is left open: the PMS5003 pulls it up inside (Plantower manual v2.3).
D8, D9, D10 (GPIO7/8/9) carry the Wio-SX1262 SPI. No connector uses them.
25 mm clear above the XIAO for the Wio-SX1262 and a path for its U.FL pigtail.

g.text: Bayu Anchor · Bayu Core connector map, phase 1 · rev 2026-10-24
